verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a Create Event API that records custom activity against a specific profile, accepts arbitrary event data without a predefined schema, and offers mobile SDK event tracking. It also documents that flows (automations) can be set up based on Klaviyo events, and a community user describes tagging events and acting on them with automated emails. However, no evidence explicitly states that a custom API-fired event triggers a flow scoped to exactly the profile on that event. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on custom-metric-triggered flows targeting the event's profile, trigger latency/filter details, hands-on corroboration of the API-event-to-flow path.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fire a custom event from my product and have it trigger an automation for exactly that person
